en: HealingEffect Flask health change on drink
fr: Flacon d'huile puissante : changement de santé au moment de boire

en: HealingEffect flask side effect of health change on drink. This value is added on top of the global amount and is scaled by potion strength (potion strength scaling can be turned off for side effects). This is an actual value and not a percentage. Positive values increase health, negative values decrease health. (0 = disabled)
